privacy_model: Local dictation, no telemetry, no cloud transcription endpoint

network_calls.name: macos_first_launch_model_download
network_calls.when: First launch until the model weights are cached locally; again if the local cache fails its integrity check and is re-downloaded; again when the user chooses Reset Speech Model Cache
network_calls.purpose: FluidAudio downloads the Parakeet TDT v3 CoreML model weights
network_calls.data_sent: Standard HTTPS request metadata; no dictation audio. If HF_TOKEN, HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN, or HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN is set in the environment, FluidAudio attaches it as an Authorization header to huggingface.co; most users do not have these set

network_calls.name: windows_first_launch_model_download
network_calls.when: First Windows launch until the NVIDIA Parakeet TDT v3 model weights are cached locally
network_calls.purpose: Transformers downloads the Parakeet TDT v3 model weights for local CUDA inference
network_calls.data_sent: Standard HTTPS request metadata; no dictation audio, transcript, settings, or usage data

network_calls.name: macos_update_check
network_calls.when: Every 6 hours when automatic update checks are enabled, plus one check shortly after launch
network_calls.purpose: Check whether a newer Presspeech release is available and notify the user
network_calls.data_sent: GET with a fixed User-Agent header, exactly presspeech-update-check; no version, device, or user identifiers, and no transcript, microphone audio, settings, or usage counts

network_calls.name: windows_update_check
network_calls.when: At most once every 24 hours when automatic checks are enabled, plus manual checks from the tray menu
network_calls.purpose: Find a newer complete windows-vX.Y.Z release and offer it to the user
network_calls.data_sent: GET with a fixed User-Agent header, exactly presspeech-windows-update-check; no version, device, or user identifiers, and no transcript, microphone audio, settings, or usage counts

network_calls.name: user_triggered_install_or_update
network_calls.when: Only when the user downloads the app directly, installs through Homebrew, or chooses to update through the menu or Homebrew
network_calls.purpose: User-triggered install/update flow: direct release download, a Homebrew metadata refresh followed by the signed macOS archive, or a Windows installer whose published size and SHA-256 are verified before launch
network_calls.data_sent: Browser or Homebrew request metadata; no dictation audio

local_storage.transcripts: Recent transcript history is in memory only and clears on quit
local_storage.clipboard: Pasted transcripts go through the system pasteboard and stay there until overwritten; Presspeech deliberately does not restore the previous clipboard contents, so the last dictation remains visible to clipboard managers and Universal Clipboard
